check_vasp_electronic_convergence: check if a VASP DFT calculation converged electronically by parsing the OSZICAR file
count_vasp_scf_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
review_converged_oszicar: review the converged_oszicar function to understand how it checks VASP electronic convergence using NELM and EDIFF thresholds
refactor_converged_oszicar: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support custom convergence criteria or additional VASP output formats
summarize_count_scf: summarize the count_scf function that aggregates SCF and ionic step counts across all OSZICAR files in a path
